description:
Inspect supported Unity text-serialized assets: .unity, .prefab, .asset, .mat, .anim, .controller, .overridecontroller, .playable, and .mask. Use a read-only unity_execute script for importer/binary assets such as models, textures, and audio.

path is the asset path plus an optional Property Tree child path. Read a known exact target directly; otherwise start at the asset root and follow returned child paths, or use unity_yaml_search to locate it. Returned paths also address subassets and referenced SubScenes; reuse them unchanged.

The source label is [source: live Editor] (including unsaved changes) or [source: disk YAML] fallback. Scene roots return hierarchy; read a GameObject/component path for its fields. Prefab values are effective values with overrides marked. Repeated instances may be folded, while indexed paths stay readable. Only requested hierarchy annotations use world-space transforms; serialized Transform fields retain their own local-space names.

Small trees expand non-array descendants within 4,000 characters; larger trees use depth. Arrays stay bounded by max_array_items, with later indices directly addressable. Results expose structured projections rather than raw YAML.

path.description: Asset-qualified Property Tree path such as `Assets/Actions/LightNormalAttack1.asset` or `Assets/Actions/LightNormalAttack1.asset/hitTrack/clips/4`. Use `~0` for `~` and `~1` for `/` inside one field-name segment.

depth.description: Child levels when non-array expansion exceeds 4,000 characters; otherwise the compact tree expands fully. Default 2, maximum 4. Arrays remain capped by max_array_items.

max_array_items.description: Maximum displayed elements per array, default 4; later indices remain directly addressable.

hierarchy_fields.description: Inline hierarchy metadata, default layer/tag/components. Use [] for names only. world_position/world_rotation/world_scale are world-space annotations; rect appears only on RectTransforms. Request only needed fields.
